body.input: Which health tech companies opened an office in Germany in 2026?

response.content:
Based on available information, I was unable to find a comprehensive list of health tech companies that specifically opened a new office in Germany in 2026. However, here are some relevant developments involving health tech companies with notable activity in Germany during 2026:

- **Flatiron Health** — This U.S.-based healthtech company focused on oncology has an active Berlin office and presented research at the ESMO AI & Digital Oncology Congress 2026 in Berlin (November 2026). Its Berlin office, situated near the city center close to the Admiralbrücke Bridge, has been described as recently renovated.

- **Cello Health Insight** — Launched operations in Germany with a new Berlin office and appointed two regional directors (Heike Tombrink as country head and Matthias Heurich as regional director) to lead its business insights and analytics division in the German market. *(Note: the exact year of this opening could not be confirmed as 2026 from the sources available.)*

- **Siemens Healthineers** — While already headquartered in Germany, the company announced plans in 2026 to rebrand as simply "Healthineers" as part of its planned spin-off and deconsolidation from Siemens AG in 2027.

Several major health tech events took place in Germany in 2026 — including the World Health Summit (Berlin, October), MEDICA (Düsseldorf, November), and Bits & Pretzels (Munich, September) — attracting numerous international healthtech companies, though specific new office openings by those attendees were not confirmed in the sources reviewed.

If you are looking for a specific company or a more targeted time frame within 2026, I'd be happy to refine the search.

explainability.content: Flatiron Health is reported to have a recently renovated Berlin office, described in an article dated October 2026, indicating the office was operational in Germany during 2026.
Flatiron Health’s participation in the ESMO AI & Digital Oncology Congress 2026 in Berlin further confirms its active presence in Germany in 2026.
Cello Health Insight announced the launch of a new Berlin office and the appointment of regional directors, showing that the company opened an office in Germany (the source is from 2026).

Flatiron combines real-world oncology data with scientific and clinical expertise to support decisions across drug development. The company applies this approach through predictive modeling, digital twins, and Flatiron Telescope, an AI-powered platform for exploring real-world oncology data and generating insights. Across these applications, rigorous methodology, clinical validation, and expert judgment help determine which questions the data can answer with confidence.

To learn more or request a meeting with the Flatiron team in Berlin, visit the Flatiron Health ESMO AI 2026 event page.

About Flatiron Health [...] Flatiron Health today announced that it will present two research posters and give a featured talk at the ESMO AI & Digital Oncology Congress 2026, taking place November 16–18 in Berlin, Germany. The studies examine how researchers can evaluate the accuracy of clinical variables extracted by large language models (LLMs) from oncology records in Germany and the United Kingdom. The featured talk will explore how predictive models built with real-world data could inform drug development decisions. [...] About Flatiron Health

Flatiron Health is a healthtech company working to improve and extend lives by learning from the experience of every person with cancer. Flatiron works with oncology practices, health systems, researchers, and life sciences companies to advance cancer care and accelerate research through technology and real-world evidence. ### SEPARATION PLANNED FOR 2027

The name change forms part of Siemens’ wider plans to deconsolidate Siemens Healthineers through a spin-off in 2027.

The proposed separation will be put to shareholders of both companies for approval at their respective annual meetings in February 2027. The adoption of the Healthineers name will also require approval at the Siemens Healthineers annual shareholders’ meeting.

The rebranding process is expected to begin once the spin-off has been entered into the German Commercial Register, completing the company’s separation and deconsolidation from Siemens. [...] For Bernd Montag, President and CEO of Siemens Healthineers AG, the Healthineers name represents the company’s identity and ambitions as it moves towards independence, whilst retaining its connection to its heritage.

“Siemens is where we have come from and remains an important and treasured part of our heritage. Healthineers is who we are – engineers and pioneers in healthcare.

> “After the deconsolidation from Siemens, we will write the next chapters of our journey in the Healthineers name and will continue pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare for everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.“
>
> Bernd Montag, President and CEO, Siemens Healthineers AG

### SEPARATION PLANNED FOR 2027 [...] Roland Busch, President and CEO of Siemens AG, described the decision as a natural progression of the company’s journey.

“This is the logical next step in a journey we started years ago – and one that has proven hugely successful,” said Busch.

> “Siemens Healthineers has grown from its Siemens roots into a global leader in its own right. It is only natural that this evolution is reflected clearly in how the company presents itself to the outside world.
>
> Roland Busch, President and CEO, Siemens AG

“For Siemens, this sharpens our profile as the company that scales AI in the real world. Our unique ability to combine the real and digital worlds makes this possible, accelerating profitable growth.”

Three forces pushed it there. First, the valuation gap. Health companies raised at 2021 multiples and are selling into a market that prices them on 2026 revenue and 2026 evidence. Neither side can agree on a number, so they agree on a formula instead. Second, regulatory timing. A company whose value depends on a CE mark under the EU Medical Device Regulation, an AI Act conformity assessment, a NICE recommendation or a German DiGA listing is worth very different amounts depending on whether those arrive.
